title: Stop the test-run registration check from reporting "native wait unavailable" for registration-sourced runs the host accepts
outcome: Stop the test-run registration check from reporting "native wait unavailable" for registration-sourced runs the host accepts
acceptance: For a run whose host registration is confirmed only by source=registration (not yet indexed), scripts/test-run-registration.mjs no longer reports the native wait as unavailable or tells the agent to use --notify. It either reports the host's actual wait admission or says plainly that wait admission was not checked. A behavioural test covers the registration-sourced case.
